title: Okróshka – Russian Kombucha Soup
notes: This is a cold soup usually served in summer.

ingredientSections.heading: Optional Ingredients
items: Boiled meat, especially beef tongue, sliced thinly

methodSections.heading: Okróshka
steps: Slice all the vegetables finely and arrange in a shallow bowl.
Top with parsley or cilantro and sprinkle with a generous amount of salt.
Pour the kombucha (a plain floavored, sour kombucha is best) over all the vegetables and add a dollop of yogurt or sour cream. Serve.
